name: Legal compatibility

subjectOf.text: Dynamic regulatory supplements do not violate the procedural protections mandated by the Administrative Procedure Act, because the full lawmaking process still applies and dynamic regulation only supplements and optimizes the existing rulemaking process.
subjectOf.abstract: Dynamic regulatory supplements would not violate mandated regulatory procedures in the APA135 as the full lawmaking process still applies.136 Dynamic regulation functions as a regulatory supplement to help optimize the existing rulemaking process.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Erik P.M. Vermeulen, Venture Capital as Dynamic Regulation of Disruptive Innovation (2016). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2740477
scope_conditions: United States administrative law under the APA

subjectOf.text: Traditional limited liability entities can only partially benefit from blockchain based governance, because the dynamic regulatory features it offers are partially incompatible with the rule based legal environment those entities must comply with.
subjectOf.abstract: Blockchain-based corporate governance offers dynamic regulatory features that are partially incompatible with the rule-based traditional legal environment that traditional limited liability entities are required to comply with.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Blockchain-Based Corporate Governance (2019). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3441904
